why_it_moved.text: No segment cuts were read, so the mechanism behind the Successful Search Rate gain is not known.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: More data that narrows Abandonment Rate to inside its 1.00% margin would clear the guardrail.
Abandonment Rate staying near +0.60% or worse with more data would make it a clear harm.
A pre-exposure comparison and a daily series by days since first exposure would fill the two checks that could not run.
